snippet.title: Flipping Is Hard - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Our steam page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826670/Flipping_is_Hard/

Flipping Is Hard is a precision platformer where you control an old flip phone fighting its way back to its boy. Inspired by Getting Over It and Only Up, the game mixes adventure, physics, and precision platforming across surreal levels like blanket forts, toy chests, and forgotten fridges. Fall, learn, climb again - because every flip matters.
